data.one_liner: Access CPU and memory usage, container-aware, pure Dart on Linux, FFI on macOS
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to read CPU load, CPU limits, memory usage and limits, and detect container environments. It uses cgroup files on Linux and native dylibs on macOS.
use_when: Need to monitor system resources in a Dart/Flutter app
Running in containers and want metrics relative to limits
Cross-platform (Linux/macOS) resource monitoring without native dependencies on Linux
avoid_when: Running on Windows or unsupported platforms
You need advanced profiling or GPU metrics
You need to run on iOS/Android
strengths: Pure Dart on Linux eliminates native binaries
weaknesses: Not supported on Windows, iOS, Android
No support for other platforms like web or mobile
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, call SystemResources.init() on macOS, no special permissions needed
